status: Post-source exploratory aggregate-data audit; no preregistration or blinded selection claim

bounded_sources.role: Human-cell construct active contraction, force calculation and recovery/creep qualification
Separate native human passive tensile reference, all six Table2 rows and Table1 regimes
Age/niche and attachment-function eligibility context only; no new numerical animal or marker inference

stop_rule: Source set frozen after source inspection and access qualification; no further retrieval retries, broad search or contacts
operations: Extract printed aggregate numbers only; no plot digitization, invented individual trajectories or inferred donor means
Recompute magnetic post force from reported stiffness and deflection; calculate contraction relative to source acellular length
Preserve original aggregate spread labels: Figure2 mean+/-SEM; bare-post deflection spread unspecified in main-text paragraph
Native: preserve six Table2 means/SDs and source transition-strain labels, summarize E2/E1 and 5N/1N-regime ratios of means without inferential statistics
Keep loading rate and peak force as coupled source regimes, not isolated independent effects
Do not convert post bending stiffness into tissue elastic modulus without construct gauge length/cross-section and passive tissue slope
Qualify age-by-niche, bilateral insertion, recovery, position and physiological durability separately; do not combine endpoints across sources

units.magnetic: Heterogeneous PDL-cell constructs derived from one source-described healthy human donor; numeric donor age unavailable in accessed main article; constructs nested in source cell preparation
units.native: 18 root-level slices from6 teeth from3 male cadavers ages31-52; individual ages, tooth/donor/slice crosswalk and raw mechanics not available in accessed public tables; four cycles are repeated measurements
units.viscoelastic: Human PDLSCs from6 donors ages18-30; no per-donor age/assay crosswalk in accessed article; human culture and rat replantation are separate units

excluded_inferences: Individual recovery fraction or recovery distribution
Joint attachment-function success across unlinked source units
Biological rejuvenation or human treatment benefit
publication: Raw source bytes remain ignored; release only attributed numerical aggregate extracts, original calculations and source qualification. The failed DOCX response remains classified as HTML, not a supplement. No figure reproduction or article text redistribution.
